blanket_lifetime_fpy.reference: Authored verification interval from archived FARIS fixed blanket history: 79859518.3 seconds divided by 365.25-day year; this is simulation output, not measured service life.

blanket_replacement_days.reference: Authored 60-day blanket replacement duration recorded in archived FARIS fixed blanket histories; used as a verification assumption, not a plant measurement.

combined_replacement_days.reference: Authored zero because combined maintenance is outside this blanket-only verification scope; PROCESS field retained explicitly.

divertor_lifetime_fpy.reference: Authored at exactly 2 × the blanket full-power interval so pinned PROCESS 3.4.2 Ward–Taylor uses n = ceil(longer_life / shorter_life) − 1 = 1 blanket-only maintenance between its combined-cycle boundaries. Zero divertor replacement time keeps this an explicit schedule control, not a divertor service-life claim or physical input.

divertor_replacement_days.reference: Authored zero because divertor is outside this blanket-only verification scope; PROCESS field retained explicitly.

net_electric_power_mw.reference: Authored shared normalization only; PROCESS Availability does not calculate net electrical power.

plant_horizon_years.reference: Authored as 2 × 79,859,518.2721506 s + 60 days − 600 s; the margin is one configured FARIS history step to avoid counting a replacement exactly at the horizon.

pulse_burn_seconds.reference: Authored 5,633 s repeat pulse boundary shared with bluemira; burn time equals pulse total so PROCESS adds no pulsing downtime.

pulse_total_seconds.reference: Authored 5,633 s repeat pulse boundary shared with bluemira; burn time equals pulse total so PROCESS adds no pulsing downtime.

unplanned_unavailability.reference: Authored deterministic zero-unplanned verification control; values are not empirical failure rates.
